about.description: Sail Wild Hearts is a 53-foot open-ocean yacht offering sailing excursions in Orange Beach, Perdido Key, and Gulf Shores, Alabama. Docked at Perdido Beach Resort's bayside dock in Orange Beach, the vessel provides various cruise options including dolphin cruises, sunset sails, paddleboard adventures, and private charters.
about.elevator_pitch: Experience Gulf Coast sailing adventures aboard a 53-foot yacht with stunning views of Orange Beach, Perdido Key, and Gulf Shores waters.
about.vibe: Relaxing, family-friendly, adventurous water-based experiences with opportunities to see dolphins and explore pristine waterways in premium comfort
about.insider_tip: Winner of Best Boat Tour for the past 6 years and ranked #5 Best Boat Tour in the U.S. in 2025
